categories.main_business_segments: Coca-Cola Consolidated operates three business segments, with the vast majority of revenue and income from operations generated by its Nonalcoholic Beverages segment. The other two segments, Data Ventures, Inc. and Red Classic subsidiaries, are combined as 'All Other' due to their smaller scale. The company is primarily a bottler, manufacturer, and distributor of nonalcoholic beverages, especially products of The Coca-Cola Company.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes large-scale beverage manufacturing and bottling technologies, producing both sparkling (carbonated) and still (noncarbonated) beverages. Production relies on proprietary concentrates and syrups from The Coca-Cola Company and other partners, with packaging in plastic bottles and aluminum cans sourced from co-owned cooperatives. Distribution is managed through a network of company-owned vehicles, warehouses, and advanced IT systems (CONA System) for operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Coca-Cola Consolidated serves a broad range of customers, including grocery stores, mass merchandisers, club stores, convenience stores, drug stores, restaurants, schools, amusement parks, and vending outlets. Its largest customers are Walmart Inc. and The Kroger Co., which together accounted for 36% of bottle/can sales volume and 29% of net sales in 2024. The company also serves on-premise and immediate consumption channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in 14 states and the District of Columbia, covering five principal U.S. markets: the Carolinas, Central (KY, WV, OH, IN, PA), Mid-Atlantic (MD, VA, DC, DE, PA), Mid-South (AR, TN, KY, MS), and Mid-West (IN, OH, IL). It serves approximately 60 million consumers through 10 manufacturing plants and 60 distribution centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Coca-Cola Consolidated operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the beverage supply chain. It manufactures, bottles, and packages beverages, then distributes and markets finished products to retailers and other customers. The company also purchases finished goods from other bottlers and participates in supply chain cooperatives for packaging materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include commercial execution, revenue management, supply chain optimization, cash flow generation, and digital transformation (notably through the MyCoke platform). The company invests in automation, fleet, and supply chain improvements, and collaborates with The Coca-Cola Company and other bottlers on new product introductions and packaging innovations. There is a strong focus on operational efficiency, customer service, and adapting to evolving consumer preferences.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of bottled and canned beverages to retail and on-premise customers, with additional income from sales to other bottlers, post-mix/fountain sales, transportation, and equipment maintenance services. The company receives marketing and distribution funding from brand partners and collects service fees for certain distribution arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from other bottlers and distributors, especially those affiliated with PepsiCo and, in some regions, Dr Pepper. It is the largest Coca-Cola bottler in the U.S. and leverages exclusive territorial rights, strong brand portfolios, and operational scale to maintain a leading position in its markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Coca-Cola Consolidated reported net sales of $6.9 billion, a 3.7% increase over the prior year, with net income of $633 million. The company has demonstrated steady growth in both revenue and profitability, supported by pricing actions, product mix, and operational improvements. It employs approximately 17,000 people and maintains a strong balance sheet with significant cash reserves and access to capital.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes exclusive distribution rights for some of the world's most recognized beverage brands, operational excellence, and superior customer service. Its value proposition includes a broad and evolving product portfolio, strong local market presence, efficient supply chain, and deep relationships with major retailers. Differentiation is further supported by investments in technology, community engagement, and a purpose-driven corporate culture.
